name: Melee PC
game: Super Smash Bros. Melee (GameCube, USA revision 2)
notes: Personal source build of 999sian/melee-pc 0.4.2 with maintained compatibility patches. Build locally on an Apple Silicon Mac or on GitHub in a private repository.

steps: Install {file} using your signing tool, or import it into your existing LiveContainer setup. Keep your existing app and saves when installing a different port; saves are not migrated automatically.
Open Melee PC, tap Choose Disc and select your own USA revision 2 (NTSC-U 1.02) disc image from Files.
Keep this personal IPA private. Follow the linked setup guide for installation and updates.

off_mac.text: Build Melee PC for iPhone/iPad on GitHub’s hosted Mac from your browser. Use a private copy of PadMint so the personal IPA stays private. Follow the guide to import the repository, run the melee-pc workflow and download your IPA. Your disc stays on your device. GitHub Actions usage limits apply.
